With a 20 amp rating, this PCB can handle a substantial amount of current, making it suitable for medium to large-scale solar installations. Its compatibility with Luminous controllers ensures seamless integration and reliable performance within the brand's ecosystem. Whether you're upgrading an existing Luminous solar setup or building a new one, this PCB offers a convenient and compatible solution.
